headline: Pierdon mining
title: Pierdon | Alpha That Drops Ore Coal And Sulfur | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need ore, coal and sulfur in Palworld one point zero? Fight the alpha Pierdon on Flamepulse Islet. Pierdon is a Ground type with Mining level five, so it is a strong worker for a mining base too. Its partner skill, Power Stone, boosts damage against enemies hit with Muddy. Grass attacks hurt it most. Will you hunt it? Comment below!
description: Pierdon in Palworld 1.0 is a Ground alpha on Flamepulse Islet that drops ore, coal and sulfur and works at Mining level five.
